description: Curated SecHub Resources SC4S pack for Cloudflare Logpush and Zero Trust security/access records relayed as one JSON record per line, covering HTTP request, WAF/firewall, Access, Gateway DNS/HTTP/Network, and audit-log families.

normalized_fields.user: Access/Gateway/audit user or actor identity where present
normalized_fields.dest: Request host or URL host context
normalized_fields.action: Native Cloudflare action/decision token; not normalized away from vendor semantics
normalized_fields.http_user_agent: HTTP user-agent from Cloudflare HTTP/Gateway HTTP records
normalized_fields.status: HTTP response/status code from Cloudflare HTTP/Gateway HTTP records
normalized_fields.cache_status: Cloudflare cache status from HTTP request records
normalized_fields.service_token_id: Cloudflare Access service-token identifier when present
normalized_fields.app: Cloudflare Access application name or Gateway detected protocol context
normalized_fields.src_internal_ip: Gateway Network internal source IP context
normalized_fields.sni: Gateway Network TLS SNI where present

explicit_gaps: No live Cloudflare Logpush or Zero Trust relay was exercised by adding this harness.

The harness uses synthetic-equivalent fixture JSON and does not prove selected-field Logpush jobs, object-store/API collectors, webhook receivers, tenant export completeness, or action-specific audit Metadata schemas.
Passing the harness would be lab replay/read-back evidence for this fixture route only, not field validation for a real Cloudflare tenant.

source.reference: Official Cloudflare Logpush and field-reference documentation for HTTP requests, firewall events, Access requests, Gateway DNS, Gateway HTTP, Gateway Network, and account audit logs; fixtures are synthetic-equivalent examples shaped to public documentation. Elastic Cloudflare integration evidence is used only for conservative HTTP/logpull and audit field-family comparison. The Splunkbase Cloudflare App public listing is used only for sourcetype compatibility notes; no third-party parser logic or fixtures are copied.
source.notes: Fixtures use example.test identities and RFC5737 documentation IP ranges; no Cloudflare customer or tenant data.

pack_variants.label: Cloudflare Logpush JSON relay
pack_variants.description: Cloudflare HTTP request and firewall/WAF Logpush records split into one JSON object per line.
known_limitations: No live Cloudflare Logpush relay replay/read-back captured.
Selected-field Logpush jobs and collector wrappers require local comparison.
pack_variants.event_boundary: one Cloudflare Logpush JSON object per physical line after HTTP destination, object-store, API, or collector envelope unwrapping; no Logpush file/archive wrapper or array batching is fixture-backed
pack_variants.events_per_file_or_message: one source record per relayed syslog/message line; source files, object-store batches, and compressed archives may contain many records but must be decompressed and split before SC4S relay
pack_variants.uniqueness_or_multiline: fixture-backed records are unique single-line JSON events; multiline JSON, nested collector wrappers, selected-field schema drift, and batched source files require local normalization before relay
pack_variants.field_delimiting_or_escaping: JSON object syntax with standard quoting/escaping; preserve nested Cloudflare request, rule, action, metadata, Ray ID, host, URI, status, and source IP fields without lossy flattening
pack_variants.timestamp_timezone: HTTP request fixtures use EdgeStartTimestamp and WAF/firewall fixtures use Datetime as UTC ISO-8601 source timestamps; syslog wrapper time is relay metadata only until local read-back verifies precedence

pack_variants.label: Cloudflare Zero Trust Access/Gateway JSON relay
pack_variants.description: Cloudflare Access, Gateway DNS, Gateway HTTP, and Gateway Network records preserving user/device, policy, decision, query, and URL context.
known_limitations: No real Zero Trust relay replay/read-back captured.
Plan/product-enabled fields may vary by deployment.
pack_variants.event_boundary: one Zero Trust Access or Gateway JSON object per physical line after Logpush/API/collector envelope unwrapping; no API page, archive, or array wrapper is fixture-backed
pack_variants.events_per_file_or_message: one source record per relayed syslog/message line; Access, Gateway DNS, Gateway HTTP, and Gateway Network batches must be split before SC4S relay
pack_variants.uniqueness_or_multiline: fixture-backed records are unique single-line JSON events; multiline records, nested collector envelopes, and tenant-specific selected-field layouts require local normalization before relay
pack_variants.field_delimiting_or_escaping: JSON object syntax with standard quoting/escaping; preserve user, device, source IP, query, URL, policy, action/decision, session, destination, and SNI fields without lossy flattening
pack_variants.timestamp_timezone: Zero Trust fixtures use Timestamp or Datetime as UTC ISO-8601 source timestamps depending on dataset; syslog wrapper time is relay metadata only until local read-back verifies precedence

pack_variants.label: Cloudflare account audit JSON relay
pack_variants.description: Conservative account audit log records preserving actor, action, resource, interface, and raw metadata context.
known_limitations: Action-specific Metadata schemas are not normalized by the initial pack.
pack_variants.event_boundary: one Cloudflare account audit JSON object per physical line after audit Logpush/API/collector envelope unwrapping; no API page, archive, or array wrapper is fixture-backed
pack_variants.events_per_file_or_message: one audit source record per relayed syslog/message line; source exports may contain many records but collector must split before relay
pack_variants.uniqueness_or_multiline: fixture-backed audit record is a unique single-line JSON event; action-specific Metadata shapes remain raw and require local sample comparison before normalization
pack_variants.field_delimiting_or_escaping: JSON object syntax with standard quoting/escaping; preserve actor, action, resource, interface, ID, and raw Metadata fields without lossy flattening
pack_variants.timestamp_timezone: Audit fixture uses When as a UTC ISO-8601 source timestamp; syslog wrapper time is relay metadata only until local read-back verifies precedence

cribl.notes: Use after sampling the local Cloudflare feed. Do not drop Ray/request ID, identity, source IP, host/URL/query, action/decision, policy/rule, or audit metadata by default.

vector.notes: Vector support is recorded as a conservative sources/transforms/sinks mapping only: collector/API relay path; keep credential custody and checkpoints outside this pack and preserve source timestamps and raw payloads. No Vector config artifact is generated by this pack yet.

fluent_bit.notes: Fluent Bit support is recorded as a conservative collector/pipeline mapping only: collector/API relay path; keep credential custody and checkpoints outside this pack and preserve source timestamps and raw payloads. No Fluent Bit config artifact is generated by this pack yet.

known_limitations: No live Cloudflare relay, SC4S runtime replay, or Splunk read-back evidence; keep curated/unverified and do not promote to validated/verified.
Fixtures are synthetic-equivalent examples, not real tenant records.
Elastic integration evidence supports conservative HTTP/logpull and audit field-family comparison only; it does not prove every Access/Gateway/DLP/CASB family or justify copied fixtures.

Splunkbase Cloudflare App evidence supports JSON and Zero Trust sourcetype compatibility notes, but local deployments may require non-lossy search-time bridging because this pack uses more explicit family sourcetypes; docs/splunk_cloudflare_app_bridge.md records a conservative design and is not validation evidence.
GitHub/community parser search did not find high-confidence reusable Logstash/Vector/Fluent Bit/Cribl parser evidence; collector-wrapper compatibility remains unproven.
Account audit Metadata remains raw/conservative because action-specific schemas vary.
Reduction candidates are opt-in and review-required; no default lossy drops are included.
